scripts.overlays: npx wrangler d1 execute camo-track-overlay --remote --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS overlays, MAX(updated_at) AS latest FROM overlays"
scripts.overlays:prune: npx wrangler d1 execute camo-track-overlay --remote --command "DELETE FROM overlays WHERE updated_at < datetime('now', '-90 days')"
scripts.scans: npx wrangler d1 execute camo-track-overlay --remote --command "SELECT c.channel, c.code, COALESCE(SUM(s.n), 0) AS scans, MAX(s.day) AS last_scan, c.last_seen FROM scan_codes c LEFT JOIN scans s ON s.code = c.code GROUP BY c.code ORDER BY scans DESC"
